tools.name: get_business_info
tools.description: Riverview Office Cleaning's services, contact details, hours, service area, and how pricing works. Prices are only quoted after a free on-site walkthrough; the published per-square-foot range is a guide, not a quote.

tools.name: search_faq
tools.description: Answers to common questions (what is included, cost, insurance, contracts, start times). Pass a question to get the closest matches, or nothing to get every FAQ.

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Whether Riverview regularly serves a city. Walkthroughs can only be booked online for cities in the service area.

tools.name: list_walkthrough_slots
tools.description: Open start times for a free 45-minute on-site walkthrough, in America/New_York time. Times are bookable from tomorrow up to 21 days out.

tools.name: book_walkthrough
tools.description: Books a free on-site walkthrough at a time from list_walkthrough_slots, on behalf of the person you are helping. Confirm the time and every detail with them before calling. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_walkthrough" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
